customer_acme_admin: Hey team — since this morning our app started getting 403s when calling /v1/generate for the prod project. Console shows the user as having no project actions. Can you help?
maria_support: Sorry about that. Can you paste one failed curl (headers) and the request ID from the response body? Also which API key are you using (service key vs personal)?
customer_acme_admin: Using our service key bound to project `acme-prod` (rotated last week). Sample response: `{"error":{"code":403,"message":"Permission denied: project access","request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d"}}`
customer_acme_admin: curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_service_acme_prod" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-inf","input":"test"}'` (sanitized)
maria_support: Thanks. Two quick checks: 1) can another member with project-admin access hit the endpoint? 2) did you recently change org structure or SCIM groups?
customer_acme_admin: Our SSO team did a bulk group rename and an org label merge yesterday. Two engineers who previously had access now see the same 403 in Console — buttons are gray.
dan_engineer: jumping in — can you grab the /v1/auth/whoami response using the same token (we only need the `claims` section)? If you prefer, paste the JSON redacting PII.
customer_acme_admin: whoami output: `{"sub":"svc:acme-prod","scopes":["inference:generate"],"claims":{"projects":[],"roles":[]}}` — notice `projects` is empty.
sree_oncall: That points to a claim strip during SCIM/group resync. If the service principal lost mapped project roles, token will have empty project claims -> 403.
maria_support: For immediate mitigation: create a new service key scoped to `acme-prod` via Console > Project Settings > API Keys and swap it in. That will validate whether the problem is token claim vs backend permission state.
customer_acme_admin: Can we avoid rotation? Rotation is painful right now (multiple deploys). Any way to reapply the project role to existing service principal?
dan_engineer: We can re-propagate role bindings from the user/group sync. Two options: 1) ask IdP team to reverse the recent group rename and trigger a full SCIM push, or 2) we (support/eng) run a targeted role propagation for `svc:acme-prod` to rebind project roles. I can run propagation if you grant consent for us to make the change.
customer_acme_admin: Consent granted. Please go ahead.
ci-bot: queued job: role-propagation svc:acme-prod -> pending (job#789) :gear: 
maria_support: Dan, can you confirm what you'll change? We need an audit-friendly approach.
dan_engineer: I'll run a one-off backend job that reconciles the service principal's group mappings with current role catalog. This will add back `project:acme-prod:developer` and any explicit admin binds. I'll include a diff in the audit log.
sree_oncall: Also scheduled a short window to watch for auth churn (5m) in case other tokens age out.
ci-bot: job#789 status: success. Applied 1 role binding.
customer_acme_admin: Confirmed — endpoints returning 200 again. Console actions restored. Huge thanks.
maria_support: Glad that worked. Follow-ups: 1) we'll coordinate with IdP to validate SCIM mapping rules to avoid future trims; 2) consider issuing a permanent service account with explicit project bind (less fragile than relying on group claims).
dan_engineer: Filed eng ticket INF-1298 to add automated detection for claim-trim regressions (alerts if `projects` empty for service principals with previous access).
customer_acme_admin: Appreciated. Please leave the job/audit refs in the ticket. :thumbsup:
